fichas.title: Golf courses
fichas.summary: Golf courses are generally unique and require site-specific design by a multidisciplinary expert. The page describes site catchment, practice-area requirements, course land requirements, and clubhouse proximity for a nine-hole half-round option on an eighteen-hole course.
uses: Provide a nine-hole half-round option on an eighteen-hole course

dimensions.label: Catchment population for a 9-hole course
dimensions.context: Approximate number of inhabitants within a 30-minute drive, for a sufficient golf-club membership.
dimensions.ocr_raw: number of inhabitants in the area within 30 minutes by car required for a 9-hole golf course is approx. 100 000

dimensions.label: Catchment travel time
dimensions.context: Catchment area used for the stated population requirement for a 9-hole golf course.

dimensions.label: Golf club membership
dimensions.context: Approximate sufficient number of golf-club members associated with the stated catchment population.
dimensions.ocr_raw: about 300, members of a golf club

dimensions.label: Grass practice area width

dimensions.ocr_raw: width of min. 80 m in order to provide practice space for about 15 golfers simultaneously

dimensions.label: Simultaneous practice capacity
dimensions.context: Approximate number of golfers accommodated by the grass practice area.

fichas.title: Golf clubhouse space allocation plan
fichas.summary: A schematic space-allocation plan organizes clubhouse functions around a lounge and foyer, with food service, toilets, washrooms and showers, changing facilities, administration, a shop, and service rooms. An open-air terrace adjoins the lounge.
figure_refs: 3 Space allocation plan for a golf clubhouse

fichas.title: Golf course utility building
fichas.summary: A functional example of a golf-course utility building groups workshop, office, lounge, sanitary and changing areas with machine storage, paved yard, fuel, washing, small-machine storage, tools and agricultural supplies.
spaces: Workshop with car lift or pit
uses: Storage of machines, materials, fuel, tools, fertiliser and seed
figure_refs: 4 Functional example of a golf course utility building
